test_period_range_required_arguments: test period_range raises ValueError when fewer than two of start, end, periods are specified
test_period_range_too_many_arguments: test period_range raises ValueError when all three of start, end, periods are specified
test_period_range_start_end_not_nat: test period_range raises ValueError when start or end is NaT
test_period_range_periods_requires_integ: test period_range raises TypeError when periods is not an integer
test_period_range_construction_from_stri: test period_range constructs PeriodIndex from start, end, or periods with string inputs
test_period_range_construction_from_peri: test period_range constructs PeriodIndex from Period objects with upsampling and downsampling
test_period_range_mismatched_freq_raises: test period_range raises ValueError when start and end have mismatched frequencies
test_period_range_invalid_freq: test period_range raises ValueError for invalid frequency strings like 'X'
test_period_range_deprecated_freq: test period_range emits warning for deprecated frequency strings like '2MIN'
test_period_range_incorrect_case_freq: test period_range raises ValueError for incorrect case frequency strings like '2m'
